note: Round 1 screens message framings. Every concept describes the same product with the same features and price; only the framing changes, except the two controls. C0 is the site's copy on 2026-11-21 (index.html hero and start steps). C0p says the same thing as C0 in different, equally polished words: it measures how much a respondent rewards a rewrite as such (the novelty effect the design test saw, docs/38). N is a worse offer and must score lower or the panel cannot tell offers apart. P is C0 at half the Pro price and must score higher on paid intent or the panel ignores price.
